steps.title: Belly Connector & Reinforced Skids (L1)
instructions: Mount 1 Small Grid Connector `ALB Dock Conn` at origin `[X: 0, Y: 0, Z: 0]` at Level L1, facing straight DOWN (−Y).
Install 4 Conveyor Junction cubes directly above the connector to form the primary logistics trunk.
Construct reinforced dual landing skids using Heavy Armor Half Blocks at X = ±3 sb, spanning from Z −4 to +4 sb.
Mount 1× Camera `ALB Cam Belly` recessed at [X0, Z +1, L1] facing straight DOWN.
checks: Verify physical clearances and continuous conveyor flow.

steps.title: Medium Cargo Container & 8-Thruster Lift Array (L1-L2)
instructions: Mount 1 Medium Cargo Container `ALB Hold Components` (3×3×3 sb) directly above the conveyor hub at [X0, Z 0, L2-L4].
Mount 8 Small Atmospheric Thrusters into the port and starboard outrigger bays, all exhausting straight DOWN (−Y):
Assign all 8 to terminal group `ALB Thrusters Lift`.
checks: Verify physical clearances and continuous conveyor flow.

steps.title: Industrial Welder Tool Head & Target Optics (L2-L3)
instructions: Mount 1× Ship Welder `ALB Welder Nose` on the bow centerline at [X0, Z +5, L2-L3] mating directly to the forward conveyor port of the Medium Cargo Container.
Mount 1× Camera `ALB Cam Welder` directly above the tool tip at [X0, Z +5, L4] with reticle crosshairs aligned with the weld field.
Mount 2× Spotlights `ALB Light Work Port / Stbd` at [X ±2, Z +5, L4] angled 5° inward to illuminate the target block.
Mount 1× Sensor `ALB Sensor WeldZone` at [X0, Z +4, L3]. Set detection field to 2.0 m forward.
checks: Verify physical clearances and continuous conveyor flow.

steps.title: 14-Thruster 6-DOF Maneuvering Ring (L2-L4)
instructions: **Forward Cruise (4×):** `ALB Thruster Fwd 1..4` at [X ±2 to ±3, Z −5, L2-L3] facing Aft (−Z) to push Bow (+Z) (320 kN main drive).
**Reverse Braking (4×):** `ALB Thruster Rev 1..4` at [X ±2 to ±3, Z +4, L2-L3] facing Bow (+Z) to push Aft (−Z) (320 kN braking).
**Port Translation (2×):** `ALB Thruster Port 1, 2` at [X −4, Z ±1, L3] facing Port (−X) to push Starboard (+X).
**Starboard Translation (2×):** `ALB Thruster Stbd 1, 2` at [X +4, Z ±1, L3] facing Starboard (+X) to push Port (−X).
**Zenith Push-Down (2×):** `ALB Thruster Down 1, 2` at [X ±2, Z 0, L4] facing UP (+Y) to push straight DOWN (−Y).
Assign all 14 to terminal group `ALB Thrusters Maneuver`.
checks: Verify physical clearances and continuous conveyor flow.

steps.title: 4-Battery Power Vault & Avionics Spine (L3-L4)
instructions: Install 4 Small Grid Batteries `ALB Battery 1..4` in a 2 × 2 bank directly aft of the cargo hold at [X ±1, Z −2 to −3, L3].
Install 1 Small Nuclear Reactor `ALB Reactor` at [X0, Z −4, L3] plumbed into the aft fuel line.
Mount 1× Remote Control `ALB Remote Control` at [X0, Z +2, L4]. Ensure Forward = Bow (+Z) and Up = Roof (+Y).
Mount 1× Micro Gyroscope `ALB Gyro` at [X0, Z 0, L4] directly above the Center of Mass.
Mount 1× Programmable Block `[ALB] PB Utility` at [X0, Z −1, L4].
Mount 1× Radio Antenna `ALB Antenna` at [X0, Z −4, L5]. Set broadcast range to `15,000 m`†.
checks: Verify physical clearances and continuous conveyor flow.

steps.title: Armored Utility Canopy & High-Viz Rub Rails (L4-L5)
instructions: Enclose the upper avionics deck with reinforced sloped armor fairings in Manufacturing Cobalt (Slot 4).
Install continuous High-Viz Yellow (Slot 9) rub rails along the outer flanks at X = ±4 sb spanning Z −4 to +4.
Install top armor louvers over the battery bank and reactor to shield against falling gravel and debris.
Mount amber hazard beacons at [X ±4, Z +3, L4] and [X ±4, Z −3, L4].
`ALB TMR Heartbeat` (5.0 s loop) fails to receive a PB reset pulse and expires.
Immediate hardwired failsafe actions triggered by timer:
If docked at host pad when failure occurs:
checks: **Dry Mass Verification:** Spawn ALBATROSS-01 in creative; terminal reports dry mass `≈ 8.5 t`.
**Point-Blank Hover Stability:** Hover 1.5 m from an Orca hull block; release flight sticks; verify craft drifts $< 0.05\text{ m}$ over 60 seconds in Earth 1.0 g.
**Empty Hover Power:** Verify 8× lift thrusters operate at `12-14%` load (`≈ 550-600 kW` draw).
**Full Component Loading:** Fill `ALB Hold Components` with 10.0 t of steel plates and construction components (Gross mass `≈ 18.5 t`).
**Laden Hover Power:** Verify 8× lift thrusters hover cleanly at `28-30%` load (`≈ 1.25-1.30 MW` draw). Confirm T/W margin `≥ 3.50`.
**Braking Distance Verification:** Fly at 50 km/h laden; engage full reverse thrust; confirm craft decelerates to a dead stop in $< 12.0\text{ m}$† ($a \ge 16.0\text{ m/s}^2$).
**Automated Repair Trial:** Approach a damaged Remora driller frame; confirm `ALB Sensor WeldZone` detects damage at 2.0 m and auto-ignites `ALB Welder Nose`.
**Conveyor Draw Test:** Verify welder pulls steel plates continuously from `ALB Hold Components` without flow interruption; confirm full structural repair completes in $< 10\text{ seconds}$.
**Bay S2 Ingress:** Approach Orca Bay S2 at hover; align with bay guide curbs; verify lateral clearance margin is $\ge 1.5\text{ B}$ (3 sb) on all sides.
**Connector Lock & Power Shutdown:** Touch down on Bay S2 floor dock; confirm `ALB Dock Conn` locks on first contact; verify batteries switch to Recharge and thrusters cut off instantly.
**Roof Pad Docking:** Approach Mastodon Carriage 2 roof deck; align `ALB Cam Belly` with `MAS MP Conn`; touch down and verify magnetic latch.
**Consist Resupply Extraction:** Order component transfer from Mastodon FOB workshop into `ALB Hold Components`; verify restock completes in $< 15\text{ seconds}$.
**Base Terminal Capture:** Touch down on Ground Base utility gantry pad; confirm 4× Small Batteries pull full 4.0 MW shore charge, reaching 100% state of charge in $< 30\text{ minutes}$.

**Simulated PB Crash:** Recompile `[ALB] PB Utility` with an empty script during 50 m/s flight; verify `ALB TMR Heartbeat` times out at 5.0 s, dampeners engage, overrides cut, welder turns off, and craft halts into stable altitude hold.
